verdict.rationale: CockroachDB advertises itself as "PostgreSQL compatible" and supports the Postgres wire protocol/drivers, but it deliberately implements only a "familiar SQL API" rather than full Postgres semantics, and hands-on community reports cite concrete gaps — e.g. missing array columns (a core Postgres feature) that made it a non-starter for a real migration, and historically no change-notification/CDC mechanism. This means it is not a drop-in engine replacement, contradicting the 'not a lookalike subset' expectation. Missing for 10: evidence of full extension/data-type parity (e.g. array support, full pg_catalog compatibility), and no MySQL/SQLite compatibility claims exist at all.
